A♥.name: ACE OF HEARTS
A♥.under: You hand someone a feeling the size of a couch and ask them to carry it up four flights. They never agreed to the couch.
A♥.sweet_spot: You say the feeling on purpose. Then you let the silence sit until someone answers.
A♥.over: Your feelings start charging rent. People tiptoe around your mood instead of getting to know you.

2♥.name: 2 OF HEARTS
2♥.under: You agree to the restaurant, the show, the opinion. Months later you cannot remember ordering anything you wanted.
2♥.sweet_spot: You put your needs next to theirs and leave the disagreement where everyone can see it.
2♥.over: Their bad mood becomes your project. You vanish into the managing, then quietly hate them for needing it.

3♥.name: 3 OF HEARTS
3♥.under: You keep one chat warm on the side. Nothing happens. Nothing has to. It is an exit sign you leave lit.
3♥.sweet_spot: Your heart gets to have range. It does not get to use the new person as a fire escape from the current one.
3♥.over: You go all in on day one. On day forty you discover a dealbreaker, right on schedule.

4♥.name: 4 OF HEARTS
4♥.under: You run the household like a seating chart. Safe, yes. Nobody gets to move their chair.
4♥.sweet_spot: Your place is the one people can count on. You still crack a window so a feeling can get in.
4♥.over: Someone cries and you hand them a schedule. The house is spotless. It echoes.

5♥.name: 5 OF HEARTS
5♥.under: Someone asks you to stay for the weekend and you suddenly have somewhere to be. Freedom makes a great disguise.
5♥.sweet_spot: You let love keep changing shape, and you stay visible while it does.
5♥.over: You call it freedom. It looks a lot like leaving right before the relationship sends a bill.

6♥.name: 6 OF HEARTS
6♥.under: You say it's fine so often it sounds like a ringtone. Underneath, resentment is preheating.
6♥.sweet_spot: You take care of people from a full plate. You are still at the table while you do it.
6♥.over: You are the nice one, professionally. You swallow every fight, and nobody you protect ever learns what you wanted.

7♥.name: 7 OF HEARTS
7♥.under: You back away from the feeling and file it under good judgment. Cozy in there. Population: you.
7♥.sweet_spot: You see love clearly, and you let the seeing lead to feeling instead of replacing it.
7♥.over: You live in your head and call it honesty. The rest of you never gets a say in the relationship.

8♥.name: 8 OF HEARTS
8♥.under: You switch the feelings off and run on spreadsheets. Your power stays spotless because nothing soft gets close.
8♥.sweet_spot: You steady the room without taking the wheel. Nobody has to guess where they stand.
8♥.over: You hand out permission slips for how people get to feel. That is not strength. That is ownership.

9♥.name: 9 OF HEARTS
9♥.under: You throw yourself into helping, then quietly resent everyone on your back. The ideal looked lighter on paper.
9♥.sweet_spot: You stay kind and keep your hands free of other people's luggage.
9♥.over: You rescue everyone but you. Burnout shows up in a volunteer lanyard.

10♥.name: 10 OF HEARTS
10♥.under: You hold the family's emotions like a stack of coats at a party. Nobody comes back for theirs.
10♥.sweet_spot: You make space for a crowd and keep a chair in it with your name on it.
10♥.over: Every mood in the room lands on your desk. Love turns into a chore chart nobody admits exists.

J♥.name: JACK OF HEARTS
J♥.under: You date the character you wrote for them. The real person keeps auditioning and never gets the part.
J♥.sweet_spot: You bring a new angle on love, and you stay when it gets boring.
J♥.over: You write three seasons of the show before the pilot airs. Reality asks for depth and it gets cancelled.

Q♥.name: QUEEN OF HEARTS
Q♥.under: You check the room's mood before you check your own. If they look tired, your needs go back in the drawer.
Q♥.sweet_spot: You take care of people by being here, not by running a background scan for their next need.
Q♥.over: Your care tightens into control. Love starts to feel like a loan they never applied for.

K♥.name: KING OF HEARTS
K♥.under: You manage everyone's feelings from a distance nobody can cross. Untouchable is a lonely job title.
K♥.sweet_spot: You carry emotional authority and you still answer the door.
K♥.over: You set the mood and everyone obeys. Then the truth quietly stops coming to you.

A♣.name: ACE OF CLUBS
A♣.under: You research the first step until it needs its own research. Fourteen tabs, no sentence.
A♣.sweet_spot: You put the idea out while it is still warm and let it be ugly in public.
A♣.over: You win the argument before anyone else has entered the chat. The idea is closed by minute two, and so are you.

2♣.name: 2 OF CLUBS
2♣.under: You keep both tabs open forever so you never have to choose. You call it fair. It is stalling with good posture.
2♣.sweet_spot: You think out loud with someone and still walk out holding an opinion with your name on it.
2♣.over: You need the win more than the answer. Your thinking partner becomes opposing counsel.

3♣.name: 3 OF CLUBS
3♣.under: You open projects like browser tabs. None of them ever have to meet an ending.
3♣.sweet_spot: You pitch the idea in five places and still give the one that needs depth your full weight.
3♣.over: Nine half-projects, one personality trait called range. None of them stay put long enough to get good.

4♣.name: 4 OF CLUBS
4♣.under: You build a system so the question never gets in. A color-coded binder is easier to hug than not knowing.
4♣.sweet_spot: You take the mess in everyone's head and hand it back in an order they can use.
4♣.over: The system expired months ago and you are still its lawyer. Correct and outdated, at the same time.

5♣.name: 5 OF CLUBS
5♣.under: You plan the change in your head on loop and never make it. Analysis does the cardio for you.
5♣.sweet_spot: You drag a tired idea into daylight, poke it hard, and let the better one win.
5♣.over: You argue to prove you are the quicker mind. The fight is the hobby now.

6♣.name: 6 OF CLUBS
6♣.under: You hand out everything you know and keep your own authority on mute. Teaching becomes a disappearing act.
6♣.sweet_spot: You share what you know and stay visible while you do it.
6♣.over: You need to be the one who knows. People get enrolled in your class without registering.

7♣.name: 7 OF CLUBS
7♣.under: Your skepticism digs a moat. Nothing is solid enough, so you stay on the shore, correct and alone.
7♣.sweet_spot: You strip every claim down to the one bolt that holds, then you build with that bolt.
7♣.over: You make the problem so complicated nobody can act on it. Complexity is your bodyguard against shipping.

8♣.name: 8 OF CLUBS
8♣.under: You keep the sharp mind holstered. Leading would mean being seen thinking, so you pass.
8♣.sweet_spot: You build a way of thinking people can follow, and you sign your name under the decision.
8♣.over: Your intellect becomes a mute button for everyone else. Smartest in the room is now the only job you do.

9♣.name: 9 OF CLUBS
9♣.under: You keep using a map of a city that got rebuilt. You call it loyalty. It is mostly being tired.
9♣.sweet_spot: You throw out the dead system and rescue the one gear still turning.
9♣.over: You preach the map. Everyone else's view gets treated as a rough draft of yours.

10♣.name: 10 OF CLUBS
10♣.under: You hoard what you know like canned goods. Mastery in the basement.
10♣.sweet_spot: You carry a whole library in your head and keep checking books out to people.
10♣.over: You run the information like a bouncer. Your authority only works if everyone stays a step behind.

J♣.name: JACK OF CLUBS
J♣.under: The idea leaves the house half-dressed. Speed takes the place of checking whether it works.
J♣.sweet_spot: You show up with the weird new angle and hand it to someone whose job is to break it first.
J♣.over: You pitch it before you know it can survive outside your head. Excitement sprints and the work walks.

Q♣.name: QUEEN OF CLUBS
Q♣.under: Half of what you know stays in your mouth. Politeness keeps the room cozy and your brain in witness protection.
Q♣.sweet_spot: You teach from what you know, and nobody has to pass a test to hear it.
Q♣.over: You decide who is ready. Knowledge becomes a velvet rope and you hold the clipboard.

K♣.name: KING OF CLUBS
K♣.under: You sit on the call while privately believing you already know. Authority hiding in the coat closet.
K♣.sweet_spot: You make the call where everyone can see it and leave the door open to revise it.
K♣.over: Disagreement gets filed as error. People learn to nod instead of think.

A♦.name: ACE OF DIAMONDS
A♦.under: You hoard what you have and run fire drills for losing it. The real safety plan never gets written.
A♦.sweet_spot: You start the thing because you believe you can make value and keep it.
A♦.over: You stack money like it can vouch for you. Your friends start to look like line items you are beating.

2♦.name: 2 OF DIAMONDS
2♦.under: You take the smaller half so nobody can say greedy. Then you keep a silent tab only you can see.
2♦.sweet_spot: You say who pays for what before dessert. Both sides leave even.
2♦.over: You hold the purse strings like a leash. Whoever pays decides, and you always pay.

3♦.name: 3 OF DIAMONDS
3♦.under: You have six side hustles and none of them pay rent. Each one is a tab you are scared to close.
3♦.sweet_spot: You run a couple of money streams and every one has an actual invoice.
3♦.over: You sprint after the next dollar while this one is still in the mail.

4♦.name: 4 OF DIAMONDS
4♦.under: You stack cash into a bunker against chaos. Then you live in the bunker and forget there was a house.
4♦.sweet_spot: You pour a solid floor and still open the wallet when the job calls for it.
4♦.over: You keep the cash locked up even when the lock costs more than the thing behind it.

5♦.name: 5 OF DIAMONDS
5♦.under: You are so scared of losing that you stand very still in the doorway. Not choosing is your favorite safe bet.
5♦.sweet_spot: The ground shifts, you redraw the budget, and you admit it shifted.
5♦.over: You buy things to feel like you are moving. Chaos gets called freedom.

6♦.name: 6 OF DIAMONDS
6♦.under: You cover everyone and invoice no one. Generosity is a costume for never asking.
6♦.sweet_spot: You hand it over and keep your own name on the list.
6♦.over: Every favor ships with a tracking number. Helping is how you keep people on the hook.

7♦.name: 7 OF DIAMONDS
7♦.under: You refresh the bank app looking for a disaster the numbers keep refusing to show. Worry clocks in and takes over your calendar.
7♦.sweet_spot: You know your worth is bigger than the number on the app.
7♦.over: Extra money feels like a clerical error someone will fix. Scarcity keeps the keys long after the facts moved out.

8♦.name: 8 OF DIAMONDS
8♦.under: You hand the budget to someone worse at it. Power looks hot to touch, so you let it sit there going cold.
8♦.sweet_spot: Your books are open and every decision comes with a reason you can say out loud.
8♦.over: You pay people to stay in their lane. The spreadsheet quietly turns into an org chart.

9♦.name: 9 OF DIAMONDS
9♦.under: You keep pouring from a dry pitcher. Someone buys you coffee and you react like it is an accusation.
9♦.sweet_spot: You give an amount you can repeat. Then you let them pay you back.
9♦.over: You keep playing the generous one after it stopped being true. Bitterness does the job a no should have done.

10♦.name: 10 OF DIAMONDS
10♦.under: You pay your cousin's phone bill and call it family. Holding up their floor puts a lid on yours.
10♦.sweet_spot: You make enough and bolt it together so it stays standing.
10♦.over: People start to look like tools on a pegboard. You tally the win and forget who held the ladder.

J♦.name: JACK OF DIAMONDS
J♦.under: A new money idea gives you a sugar rush. Week three of actually doing it, you are gone.
J♦.sweet_spot: You test the weird new money idea and stick around long enough to get real data.
J♦.over: You sell the harvest before planting. The product is a rumor.

Q♦.name: QUEEN OF DIAMONDS
Q♦.under: The pantry is full and you still ration like the apocalypse is on your calendar. Control is doing trust's job, badly.
Q♦.sweet_spot: You keep things safe without holding a crisis meeting over every grocery run.
Q♦.over: Love comes with a bill attached. Everyone knows what letting you down costs.

K♦.name: KING OF DIAMONDS
K♦.under: You sit on the war chest and say no comment. The room still bends around the money you will not touch.
K♦.sweet_spot: You run the machine and your math is on the whiteboard.
K♦.over: Your team becomes fuel for your title. Taking care of anyone stops being part of the job.

A♠.name: ACE OF SPADES
A♠.under: You sit on the bad news like a hen on a grenade. Everyone gets the soft edit.
A♠.sweet_spot: You name the problem while it is small enough to fix. No emergency required.
A♠.over: You hand over the truth blade first, then blame their grip.

2♠.name: 2 OF SPADES
2♠.under: You open forty tabs of research until the deadline quietly expires. Diligence was a hiding spot the whole time.
2♠.sweet_spot: Two pressures, both real. You still make a call that works outside your head.
2♠.over: Your refusal to decide gets so loud the people around you start a war over it on your behalf.

3♠.name: 3 OF SPADES
3♠.under: Sadness moves in and takes every room. Nothing else gets a turn until the feeling is done, and it has no plans to be done.
3♠.sweet_spot: You let the hard feeling sit at the table, learn its name, then clear the dishes and keep going.
3♠.over: Your pain becomes the closing argument. People who did nothing get cast in a story they never auditioned for.

4♠.name: 4 OF SPADES
4♠.under: You lock the doors and call it stability. The walls are there to keep anything new on the porch.
4♠.sweet_spot: You build enough scaffolding that things can change without the ground giving out.
4♠.over: The drawbridge stays up long after the army went home.

5♠.name: 5 OF SPADES
5♠.under: You go stiff the second the fight starts and blame the situation for all of it.
5♠.sweet_spot: You stay through the rough part until you get better at it.
5♠.over: You keep a fight in your pocket to prove you are tough. Peace starts to feel like losing.

6♠.name: 6 OF SPADES
6♠.under: You patch up everyone else and leave your own cut open. Helping is how you dodge it.
6♠.sweet_spot: What you survived becomes useful. Nobody else has to hurt to make it count.
6♠.over: Your help needs a patient. When nobody is falling apart, you get weirdly restless.

7♠.name: 7 OF SPADES
7♠.under: You go straight to worst case and leave the useful version unopened.
7♠.sweet_spot: You give the ugly loop a name, then make one honest move before the dread does.
7♠.over: Hard becomes the whole philosophy. Every clean fact gets treated like a trap.

8♠.name: 8 OF SPADES
8♠.under: You put the weight down and glare at whoever lifts it. Strength left in the drawer still sends you a bill.
8♠.sweet_spot: You take the hard call, then you keep showing up for the boring part after it.
8♠.over: You steer the room by sheer brainpower. Everyone nods. Nobody tells you what is actually going on.

9♠.name: 9 OF SPADES
9♠.under: You leave the ending on the desk like a cold plate nobody clears. Finishing would mean starting over without it.
9♠.sweet_spot: You get through the hard chapter, keep the lesson, drop the rest.
9♠.over: You slam the door before the work is finished. Closing up becomes your favorite exit.

10♠.name: 10 OF SPADES
10♠.under: You carry everyone's hardest box and call it responsibility. The job never asked for this many boxes.
10♠.sweet_spot: You do the hard work in front of you and refuse the homework that belongs to someone else.
10♠.over: You raise the bar until nobody clears it, you included. Grinding takes the place of judgment.

J♠.name: JACK OF SPADES
J♠.under: You toss the truth over your shoulder and keep walking. Fallout is not your job.
J♠.sweet_spot: You call it what it is, out loud, then you stay put.
J♠.over: Honesty turns into a scoreboard. People feel the slice before they register the information.

Q♠.name: QUEEN OF SPADES
Q♠.under: You know what is going on and let their wrong version stand. You buy the quiet with your silence.
Q♠.sweet_spot: You say the needed thing at a volume someone can actually use.
Q♠.over: You sit on the key fact so you stay ahead. Knowing things becomes your private stock portfolio.

K♠.name: KING OF SPADES
K♠.under: You live upstairs in your head and lock the door to the feelings. Leading is easier when nobody can find you.
K♠.sweet_spot: You make the tough decision and still let people see there is someone home.
K♠.over: Emotion gets treated like a plumbing problem. Everyone lines up and nobody brings you anything human.
